notes: Research 2026-11-13; every source_url opened with WebFetch. No Barbados Veterinary Association clinic directory reachable (cbvma.org gives only the association e-mail; association site not found). Ministry of Agriculture Veterinary Services: no clinic list or duty rota page found. No duty rota, no animal poison line found. Unreachable: centralvetbarbados.com (robots disallowed); arkanimalwelfarebarbados.com vets-in-barbados page (http/https redirect loop, WebFetch refused twice). Clinics named only in news/expat articles with no own page found and not added: Barbados RSPCA Animal Clinic, Sandy Lane Clinic (barbadostoday/expatfocus articles, no website/phone), Eastern Veterinary Clinic, Golden Pride Veterinary Clinic (directory listings only). WellVet address page gives no street number and no phone/hours.
